question: If North becomes South-West, what will West become?
solution:
Given:

North becomes South-West → 135º Anticlockwise turn from North directions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa62fec1094a6f35d97e45c51bdc51135009602e75f6c4cce7db391a3de06a5d.png] 

Thus, South becomes South-East.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
